records.text: An anonymous source alleged that Hansen Mortuaries refused to participate in a mock burial for Charlie Kirk, after which Turning Point USA sought another venue and ultimately chose the Catholic Church because of Erika Kirk's ties to priests.
records.speaker: Anonymous Source #1 (Ep AoYZel7_cGQ)

appearances.snippet: So regarding Hansen, the person alleged with proof that I deemed to be credible, that the reason that Charlie (Charlie Kirk) was brought to Hansen and was ultimately moved was because the company refused to take part in a quote-unquote mock burial. ... So I am told that Hansen declined to participate in a mock burial, so Turning Point USA then had to shop around. And ultimately, they landed upon the Catholic Church because of Erika (Erika Kirk)'s very strong ties to the priests.

verification.notes: Candace Owens says an anonymous source supplied private text messages supporting the mock-burial allegation. The source is unnamed, the messages are not available in the transcript or opened public sources, and current reporting does not independently confirm that Hansen Mortuaries refused such a request, that another venue was sought for that reason, or that a Catholic venue was selected because of priestly ties. The anonymous allegation was reviewed but cannot be externally verified.

sources.title: A Strange Thing Happened At Charlie's Funeral... Plus, A Shocking Medical Examiner Report | Ep 368
sources.relevance: Primary public record of the anonymous allegation and Owens's description of unavailable private messages; it is not independent corroboration.
